scoring_justification: Main claim is structural relationships (deviation of mixture Grüneisen from mass-weighted average and non-constancy of Γ/V). These can be verified directly from the submitted CSV; T1/T2 recompute is not needed because no hidden gold value exists that is more discriminative than the structural conditions themselves.

outputs.description: CSV of Hugoniot states and derived quantities for λ=0.5 mixture. The checker will verify that the mixture Grüneisen parameter differs from the mass-weighted average and that Γ/V is not constant across the trajectory, as claimed in the paper.

steps.description: Verify that |Gamma_mixture - Gamma_simple_avg| > 0.01 for every row and that the coefficient of variation of Gamma_over_V across all rows exceeds 0.01, as claimed in the paper.
